implementation_issues.description: Table 6 reports 477 restating firms with data, while the selection text reports only 455 firms with month −18 accrual data and gives no column-specific N. The exact Table 6 estimation sample is unresolved.
The supporting market model for Stock Volatility lacks return frequency, market benchmark, return definition and estimator; these are essential to reconstruct this control.

The paper sets absent consecutive short-interest firm-month observations to zero; distinguishing true zero from missing records and reproducing exchange/security aggregation requires data handling not fully specified by the local product fields.

The paper discusses Compustat's original and restated series and manually compares original 10-K numbers for 19 firms; current local Compustat vintage is not proven to reproduce those original-series values.

review_notes: The GAO-03-395R event list is an official public, updated release with company/ticker/market/date fields for 919 method-defined restatement entries (1997–June 2002); CRSP/security and accounting links remain separate unresolved inputs.
The baseline regression uses restating firms, not matched control firms. Matching is required only for other comparisons and is excluded from this baseline assessment.
The table's 477 versus text's 455 month−18 accrual discrepancy is preserved rather than resolved by assuming the sample count.
